source: war3map.j (BattleShips Pro v1.187), multi-agent audit pass 1
tradeRoutesProvenance: Pickup: Trig_<Goods> (H00D, UnitInventoryCount < 3) and Trig_<Goods>_Copy (H005, < 4) on the pickup rect — carrier must hold the contract item and not the goods; team-gated routes additionally require IsPlayerAlly(Player(0|1)). Delivery: Trig_South_Rewards / Trig_North_Rewards (and the Ammo twins) on gg_rct_SouthReward / gg_rct_NorthReward — registered boat of type H00D or H005, ally of that side, carrying contract + goods; goods removed, contract kept, gold/XP paid directly and udg_PlayerLumber += rewardLumber. NOT yet extracted (OPEN): the Refinery upgrade chains (Beer/RefinedWood/etc. Pick_Up swaps at gg_rct_Refinery with higher *_Rewards_Refinery payouts), the Repair Buildings Mission (I01I -> I01J Goblin Mechanic), and the 8-stage Treasure Hunts (I02H/I02I).
mechanism:
IMPORTANT NEGATIVE RESULT FIRST: BattleShips Pro v1.187's war3map.j (15,690 lines) contains NO parallel udg_ weapon-stat tables and NO periodic inventory-walking firing trigger. The script is plain GUI-generated JASS (Trig_*/InitTrig_* functions, udg_ globals at lines 1-517 only). There are ZERO UnitDamageTarget calls, no gamecache/hashtable storage, and no arrays mapping item rawcodes to damage/cooldown/range. Therefore the regular ship weapons (cannons, torpedoes, nuke, vulcan, sniper, etc.) are implemented purely in OBJECT DATA: each weapon item (war3map.w3t) grants the carrying ship an attack-granting/attack-modifying ability (war3map.w3a / dummy attack data in war3map.w3u), and the WC3 engine's native attack system fires every carried weapon automatically at enemies in range on each ability's own cooldown. Per-weapon damage, cooldown, range, AoE, and projectile art MUST be extracted from the object-data files (w3t/w3a/w3u, plus w3q for upgrades), not from the .j. The script only supplies the surrounding rules, which DO affect effective DPS and must still be honored:

1) MISSILE SYSTEM (the one genuinely trigger-fired weapon) — gg_trg_Fire_Missiles (lines 10797-11129). Event: any unit casts ability 'A032' (Fire Missiles). The caster must carry item 'I01N' (launch prerequisite, consumed per shot) plus exactly one warhead tier: 'I01O', 'I01P', or 'I01Q' (the three missile items). Missing-item branches print TRIGSTR_5100/5101/5102 and abort. On launch: (a) ability 'A032' is temporarily stripped from all of the owner's 'n00D'-type units (launch-platform throttle preventing concurrent launches) and re-added ~2 s later; (b) one 'I01N' AND the warhead item are removed (each shot consumes both); (c) WarStomp + Flare effects play on the ship and a random 1-3 roll picks gg_snd_FireMissile2/3; (d) a dummy missile unit is created at the ship — 'h00N' for I01O, 'h00O' for I01P, 'h00P' for I01Q — owned by the TEAM main player (Player(0) if the caster is allied to south, Player(1) if north); (e) the dummy is issued "selfdestruct" (Goblin Sapper Kaboom) at GroupPickRandomUnit of the ENEMY main player's units filtered IsUnitType(STRUCTURE) == true. So missiles hit a uniformly random enemy structure; their damage/AoE is the dummy unit's Kaboom ability in object data (h00N/h00O/h00P in w3u + their A-ability), one shot per cast, no periodic component. gg_trg_Buggfix (11130-11157) runs every 20 s and re-issues "selfdestruct" to leftover h00N/h00O/h00P dummies — but only Player(0)-owned ones, always targeting Player(1) structures (asymmetric bug; north's stuck missiles are never fixed).

2) CARRY-LIMIT / CLASSIFICATION TRIGGERS (pickup-event, define which rawcodes are weapons and their stack rules; all refund gold equal to R2I(GetItemLifeBJ(item)) — the item's HP field stores its gold price): Only_One_Hull I009/I016/I00A (1 per ship, banned on 'H001'); Only_One_Sail I008/I01A/I01U/I01V/I01T (1 per ship — NOT banned on subs: the keep-condition at 8919-8939 checks only for another sail or Kraken I01X, and the H00V/H00W test at 8907-8918 sits in the violation branch purely to suppress the duplicate-refund message, so a submarine may carry one sail); Only_One_Kraken I01X (exclusive with every hull/sail/repair item); Only_One_Repair I017/I00B/I011/I01W (1 per ship); Only_One_Nuke I01Y (max 1); Only_One_Vulcan I01Z (max 1); Only_One_Sniper I02F/I02M (max 1, enforced only when udg_ModeOnlySailors); Only_One_Torpedo1 I02N/I02O/I02P/I026 (max 1, submarine-only); SubItemsOnly_Copy (non-subs cannot carry ITEM_TYPE_ARTIFACT = torpedo class); SubAcquiredItems (BLACKLIST, lines 9353-9404: subs H00V/H00W may NOT carry the repair woods I00C/I00D/I00E/I01H, the repair crews I017/I00B/I011/I01W, or the Kraken I01X — Func001C returns true iff the item is NONE of those nine; a banned pickup is refunded gold = item HP field and removed, everything else is carryable, so a sub cannot self-repair but can carry ordinary weapons). No_Repair (Instant Death mode) bans I017/I00B/I011/I01W/I01X/I00F/I00T.

3) DAMAGE SCALING — Tech_Upgrade_South/North (14389-14675): upgrades 'R001'=Tower Damage, 'R000'=Tower Defense, 'R005'=Ship Cannons, 'R003'=Ship Hull, 'R004'=Ship Sails ('R002'=Tower Mechanics handled in same trigger): when any ally finishes a research, the trigger copies the new tech level to every allied player via SetPlayerTechResearchedSwap. 'R005' Ship Cannons is the team-wide multiplier on all item-weapon attack damage; per-level numbers live in war3map.w3q, not the script. This is the only damage scaling visible in script.

4) FIXED SCRIPTED DAMAGE (special cases): suicide-mission detonations apply flat damage directly to the enemy HQ building via SetUnitLifeBJ — 4000.0 (goblin-bomb run, items I01E/I01F/I01G, lines 11408-11501) and 6000.0 (superbomb chain I032->I02Z + I02Q, lines 14199-14298); the ship is exploded. GoblinBomber (8752-8805): the 'Bstt' buff (goblin land bomb) kills the buffed ship 5 s after item use/spell cast.

5) TARGETING RULES: Dont_Attack_Friends (8419-8433) issues "stop" to any unit that attacks an ally — global friendly-fire prevention applying to all weapon attacks. Items_Not_Buyable (8128-8224) blocks purchases from enemy-side shops. Lumber_Back_From_Contracts (8225-8403) gates the big contract purchases (I00S/I00W/I00M/I01I/I00Q need 4/10/10/18/25 lumber; I00U/I013/I012/I01E/I02I/I02H refund 25/50/50/80/80/80) — IMPORTANT SEMANTICS: the 'need N' amounts are udg_PlayerLumber thresholds (item removed when below, 8328-8390), and the 'refund N' amounts merely give back the ENGINE lumber charge (items.json ilum) that WC3 deducted at purchase; Trig_Lumber_Fix (7430-7441) re-syncs engine lumber to udg_PlayerLumber every 0.5 s, so every contract item is a never-consumed, never-granted lumber THRESHOLD at its items.json ilum value. udg_PlayerLumber is incremented ONLY by trade-route deliveries and the Captain Reward — purchases never mint trigger lumber. Change_Ship (1296-1637) transfers all 6 inventory slots between old and new ship via udg_PlayerHandyMan, so weapons persist across hull changes.

NET SEMANTICS FOR STAT EXTRACTION: 'damage per shot', cooldown, range, AoE and projectile of every standard weapon item are object-data attack-ability fields (extract from w3t item->ability links and w3a/w3u); the engine fires all carried weapons independently and simultaneously (no multi-shot counts in script); team upgrade R005 scales them; missiles are consumable two-item shots whose payload is the Kaboom of dummies h00N/h00O/h00P at a random enemy structure; suicide bombs are flat 4000/6000 HP removal from the HQ.

scriptedItems.special: Armed superbomb (suicide mission part 2). Requires 'H005' Trade Ship that is the player's registered boat, carrying I01E + I02Z + I02Q. Detonates on entering the enemy main-base rect (gg_rct_North_Main for south team, gg_rct_South_Main for north): subtracts a flat 6000.0 HP directly from the enemy HQ unit via SetUnitLifeBJ (bypasses armor; south hits gg_unit_n000_0018, north hits gg_unit_n000_0020). The carrying ship is destroyed (ExplodeUnitBJ). Awards 12000 gold + 1200 XP to the pilot. Single-target (HQ only), one-time consumable, no cooldown/range/projectile - delivered by sailing into the rect. Also disables gg_trg_NoSmokeSuicide on detonation.
scriptedItems.name: SuperBomb (Armed)

scriptedItems.special: Inert superbomb precursor - deals no damage itself. When a 'H005' Trade Ship carrying I01E + I032 (and NOT carrying I01G or I02Z) enters the OWN team's reward rect (gg_rct_SouthReward for south-allied via Trig_Suicide_Mission_part2_South_Refinery with IsPlayerAlly(Player(0)), gg_rct_NorthReward for north-allied via North_Refinery with IsPlayerAlly(Player(1)) — war3map.j 14131-14198), I032 is removed and the armed superbomb I02Z is added in its place; enemy team gets a 12 s minimap ping on their own main base warning of the armed bomb. I032 itself is obtained at gg_rct_Refinery by swapping I01F while carrying I02Q (Trig_Superbomb_Pick_Up1, 13640-13658 — Refinery upgrade chain, not yet modeled in the sim).
scriptedItems.name: Superbomb (Unarmed)

scriptedItems.special: Missile warhead tier 1. Cast A032 with I01N + I01O carried; consumes one of each per shot (lines 11008-11009). Spawns dummy unit h00N at the ship, owned by team main player (Player(0) if caster allied to Player(0), else Player(1)), ordered 'selfdestruct' (Goblin Sapper Kaboom) at a uniformly RANDOM enemy STRUCTURE map-wide (lines 11029-11035) - effectively unlimited range, no player aiming. Damage/AoE/speed are h00N's Kaboom ability in object data, NOT in script. Cooldown 2.0 s is a scripted per-player throttle: A032 is stripped from all owner's n00D launch platforms (line 11007) and re-added after TriggerSleepActions of 0.5+1.0+0.5 s (lines 11014, 11038, 11041, 11042). Aborts with error text if I01N or warhead missing (lines 10990-11004). Buggfix re-orders stuck h00N dummies every 20 s, but only Player(0)-owned ones and always at Player(1) structures (lines 11149, 11134, 11155 - asymmetric bug).

questSystems.provenance: Three secondary quest chains extracted faithfully from war3map.j (BattleShips Pro v1.187), all distinct from the headline I01E goblin-bomb and I032->I02Z superbomb suicide runs (already in specials.ts). All region triggers are enter-rect events (TriggerRegisterEnterRectSimple) except the two USE_ITEM reward triggers noted below. All gold via AdjustPlayerStateBJ(PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD), XP via AddHeroXPSwapped(..., true), and udg_PlayerLumber += rewardLumber after a 1-tick or 1s settle. Carrier hulls H00D (Trade Boat) / H005 (Trade Ship); both refinery hulls accepted unless noted. Region coords are gg_rct_* world rects (see map-layout.json).

refinery.doc: REFINERY CHAIN. A two-step value-upgrade of trade goods. Step 1 (refine swap): a Trade Boat/Ship carrying a RAW good AND the membership item I02Q 'Book of Formulas' enters the central gg_rct_Refinery rect; the raw good is RemoveItem'd and the matching REFINED good is added (UnitAddItemByIdSwapped). No team gate, no contract required for the swap, no inventory-count gate; both H00D and H005 accepted. Step 2 (cash-in): the ship sails to its OWN team's reward rect (gg_rct_SouthReward for Player(0) allies, gg_rct_NorthReward for Player(1) allies) carrying the ORIGINAL CONTRACT item + the REFINED good + I02Q; the refined good is RemoveItem'd (contract + I02Q kept) and gold/XP/lumber paid. Refined cash-in pays MORE than the same route's raw delivery (the existing trade-route South/North_Rewards). I02Q (Book of Formulas, igol 0, no lumber gate) is sold by BOTH Trade Masters (n00E Will south, n00F Bill north) and is never consumed. The Goblin Engineer (I01J->I031) and Golden Statue (I02G->I030) refine swaps exist but cash out via the Repair-Mission USE_ITEM reward and the Treasure reward respectively, not via the *_Rewards_Refinery triggers; they are listed separately. Refinery reward triggers gate on GetTriggerUnit()==udg_PlayerBoat (the player's registered boat) AND IsPlayerAlly(Player(0|1)). The udg_RewardRecieved flag chains the per-good if-blocks then prints one combined Reward line.

rewardRoutes.trigger: Ammo_South_Rewards_Refinery/Ammo_North_Rewards_Refinery (separate twin triggers; Ammo uses I02K contract)

refinery.rewardRoutesNote: Each refined cash-in pays exactly 1.5x the corresponding raw trade-route gold (e.g. Ale 200->refined 300, Pigs 1200->1800, Captives 4500->6750) for the same contract + same +1 lumber over the raw route's lumber; XP equals the raw route XP except captives unchanged at 850. Team gating mirrors the raw routes: ale/wood/ammo are open to both teams; pigs/boxes/north-captives are south-only; potions/books/south-captives are north-only. The captive refine (I014 OR I015 -> I02U) is consumed by whichever team's contract is carried (I013 south, I012 north).

repairMission.doc: REPAIR BUILDINGS MISSION (I01I). Step 0 (buy): I01I 'Repair Buildings Mission' (igol 0) bought from a Trade Master (n00E Will / n00F Bill); gated on udg_PlayerLumber >= 18 (Lumber_Back_From_Contracts Func006, war3map.j 8267-8277, 8355-8363) — a pure threshold, never consumed (the 18 engine-lumber ilum is refunded). Step 1 (token): a carrier holding I01I and NOT holding I01J enters gg_rct_GoblinBombShop with a free inventory slot (H00D UnitInventoryCount < 3 via Trig_Repair_Mission, H005 < 4 via Trig_Repair_Mission_Copy) -> I01J 'Goblin Mechanic' is added (UnitAddItemByIdSwapped). I01I is NOT consumed by this step. Step 2 (reward): the player USES item I01J (EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_USE_ITEM, NOT a region trigger), on an H00D/H005 -> after a 1s sleep: +700 gold, +300 XP, +3 lumber (Trig_Repair_Mission_part2_Reward, 11652-11683). REFINERY VARIANT: if the carrier instead refines the Goblin Mechanic at the Refinery (I01J + I02Q -> I031 'Goblin Engineer', Trig_Goblin_Engineer_Pick_Up, 13342-13345) and then USES I031 while carrying I02Q, the reward is upgraded: +1050 gold, +300 XP, +3 lumber (Trig_Repair_Mission_part2_Reward_Refinery, 14095-14124; 1050 = 1.5x 700). Both reward triggers are use-item; there is no 'repair a building' action in script — the name is flavor, the deliverable is the consumable Goblin Mechanic/Engineer token whose USE pays out.

treasureHunts.doc: TREASURE HUNT (I02H south / I02I north). Step 0 (buy): I02H 'Finding Treasure Contract (South)' from n00E Will (south side), or I02I 'Finding Treasure Contract (North)' from n00F Bill (north side); each igol 1000, and on purchase refunds 80 engine lumber (Lumber_Back_From_Contracts Func012/Func013, 8385-8395) — NO udg_PlayerLumber threshold (these are in the 'refund' group, not the 'need' group). Step 1 (find): exactly ONE active treasure location at a time per team, tracked by udg_SouthTreasure1 / udg_NorthTreasure1 (each a 1..8 int, both seeded to GetRandomInt(1,8) by Trig_SetTreasure at t=5s, 12501-12509). A registered H005 Trade Ship that is an ally of its team, carries the matching contract (I02H south / I02I north), does NOT carry I02G, and has UnitInventoryCount < 4, must enter the rect whose index matches its team's current treasure number -> I02G 'Treasure' is added, BOTH teams get a minimap ping + warning at that location, and the team's treasure number is REROLLED GetRandomInt(1,8). The 8 location rects (same list for both teams, indexed by number): 1=AleFactory, 2=SwedeLumberMill, 3=GoblinBombShop, 4=Pigfarm, 5=GoblinPotionShop, 6=GhostShip, 7=ElvenLibrary, 8=enemy main base (South team's #8 = North_Main, North team's #8 = South_Main). Step 2 (return): the ship sails to its OWN reward rect (gg_rct_SouthReward for I02H, gg_rct_NorthReward for I02I) carrying contract + I02G -> RemoveItem both the I02G and the CONTRACT (the contract IS consumed here, unlike trade routes), pay 14000 gold + 2500 XP + 0 lumber (Trig_SouthTreasureReward 12738-12778 / Trig_NorthTreasureReward 12696-12736). DROP HANDLING: dropping I02G (ITEM_TYPE_MISCELLANEOUS) destroys it after 0.05s if it is not back in the boat/handyman (Trig_Destroy_Treasure 11190-11220). Treasure RNG MUST draw from the match Rng for determinism. NOTE: the reward triggers gate on GetTriggerUnit()==udg_PlayerBoat (registered boat).

refinedVariant.doc: REFINED TREASURE BRANCH. A H005 carrying the Treasure (I02G) AND the Book of Formulas (I02Q) entering gg_rct_Refinery has the Treasure RemoveItem'd and the Golden Statue (I030) added via UnitAddItemByIdSwapped (Trig_Golden_Treasure_Pick_Up, 14070-14093) — the same 1.5x refinery upgrade pattern applied to treasure; no team gate, no contract required for the swap. Cash-in: a registered H005 ally entering its OWN reward rect (gg_rct_SouthReward for I02H/Player(0) allies, gg_rct_NorthReward for I02I/Player(1) allies) carrying the CONTRACT + Golden Statue (I030) + Book (I02Q) has BOTH the I030 and the CONTRACT RemoveItem'd (book kept) and is paid 21000 gold + 2500 XP + 0 lumber (Trig_SouthTreasureReward_Copy 14344-14388 / Trig_NorthTreasureReward_Copy 14296-14342; 14000*1.5 = 21000, the single largest payout in the game).
